item.title: Saving Client Data with LocalStorage
item.description: Ever refreshed a webpage only to groan because your dark-mode toggle or form inputs completely reset back to default? Yeah, we’ve all been there. :') Unless you send data to an external backend database, browser memory wipes clean the moment a user hits refresh or closes the tab. Luckily, modern browsers hand us a dead-simple persistent key-value vault: LocalStorage. The Storage Family: Local vs Session Browsers actually offer two flavors:
